text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hau~ I never imagined it would start
pouring so heavily all of a sudden...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, the concert got cancelled.
And I really wanted everyone to hear my new song, too~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: “Above all else, though! We can't let our guests catch a cold.”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*...
Even though everyone went out of their way to come...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking of the audience who came to her street performance,
Smart Falcon felt disheartened.
